# PROINVEST GLOBAL LTD

> Applied AI products for real operational workflows.

PROINVEST GLOBAL LTD is a United Kingdom technology and investment company.
UK company number: 16851428.
Registered address: 2 Frederick Street, Kings Cross, London WC1X 0ND, United Kingdom.
Official website: https://proinvest.global
Contact: info@proinvest.global

## Product portfolio

- ProHotelAI — https://prohotelai.com — AI-native hotel operations platform built around a governed Hotel Digital Brain. It connects guest concierge, hotel knowledge, operational workflows, service fulfilment, commerce, reporting and hotel data.
- ProCafeAI — https://www.procafeai.com — AI-native operations platform for cafés and restaurants.
- VisaRiskAI — https://www.visariskai.com — AI-assisted visa risk and application-readiness analysis platform.
